question: Which moment should be Gimme Some Slack's face, the one you judge it by first? (1) The workshop floor: a room of over-long cords looping across the floor, piling against the walls and plugging into a power strip at each junction, then one cord cut so its live end sparks and its dead end lies limp. (2) The yard of masts: a sagging line strung over a shed to a far mast, the mast knocked down so the wire lies sparking on the ground, a hauler shocked crossing it while the colonist sent to re-string it is safe. The other follows as showcase 2. Recommended: (1), the floor cords are what makes the mod.
